notes: Read SKILL.md and references/docker-commands.md in full. The skill covers Dockerfile best practices (multi-stage, layer caching, non-root users), building and multi-platform builds, running containers with volumes/networks/limits, lifecycle, debugging, health checks, image tagging/pushing/cleanup, a Compose example and runtime hardening flags.

Medium: following it has the agent run Docker on the user's machine: build/run/exec containers, pull and push images to registries (SKILL.md:113-119, 263-271), force-remove containers (SKILL.md:191) and prune resources, including `docker system prune -a --volumes` (SKILL.md:281, 381; references/docker-commands.md:93), which deletes all unused images and named volumes and their data. Acceptable because this is the user's own local Docker environment and the prune commands are given without `-f`, so Docker itself asks for confirmation; the agent should still get explicit user approval before pruning volumes.

The Compose example uses a placeholder `POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret` (SKILL.md:327); the skill itself advises runtime secret injection (SKILL.md:390). Related Skills (SKILL.md:400-402) link to sibling skills ../docker-compose/ and ../../../security/{scanning/container-scanning,hardening/container-hardening}/ as optional reading only.
